name: 94580 · San Lorenzo, CA
findings: ZIP 94580 (San Lorenzo) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94580 (San Lorenzo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
